name: Kang-Petrov Arms KP-19 'Workhorse'
description:
The Kang-Petrov KP-19 is a full-size duty pistol chambered in 9x19mm, built on a steel-reinforced polymer frame with a cold-hammer-forged barrel. It represents the baseline of competent firearm engineering — nothing revolutionary, nothing deficient. The action is reliable, the trigger is acceptable, and the sights are adequate steel three-dot units that hold zero indefinitely.

The KP-19 is the standard-issue sidearm for dozens of private security companies, building security teams, and licensed personal protection operators throughout the Mids. Kang-Petrov's business model is volume and consistency — every KP-19 performs identically to every other KP-19, and replacement parts are available at any hardware vendor in GLMZ.

The Workhorse earned its nickname honestly. It is the pistol that guards carry when their employer doesn't care about brand prestige but does care about liability. It works, it keeps working, and when it finally wears out after tens of thousands of rounds, the replacement costs the same as a moderately expensive dinner.
specifications:
caliber: 9x19mm
effective_range: 50 meters
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 17 rounds
weight: 0.78 kg
tactical_use: A reliable mid-range duty pistol suitable for security work and personal defense. Accurate enough for aimed fire at reasonable distances, with sufficient magazine capacity for most defensive encounters. Compatible with standard rail-mounted accessories including lights and laser designators.
cultural_context: The KP-19 is boring, and that is its virtue. Nobody brags about carrying a Workhorse. Nobody writes songs about it. It is the pistol equivalent of a sensible pair of shoes — functional, forgettable, and quietly everywhere.
story_hooks: A batch of KP-19s with modified firing pins has entered circulation — someone is building untraceable weapons from factory-standard parts.
A retired security guard's well-worn KP-19 has scratch marks inside the grip that turn out to be coordinates.

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian full-size duty pistol with a no-nonsense aesthetic. Angular polymer slide with pronounced grip angle, traditional DA/SA profile. Looks exactly like what it is: a competent tool built for repetition, not aesthetics. The kind of gun that disappears into a security guard's holster and is forgotten until needed.
physical_description.dimensions: 203mm overall length, 38mm width at widest point, 132mm height. 102mm barrel length. Proportioned for adult hands with moderate palm-swell.
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and substantial without being heavy—780 grams feels like a working tool, not a luxury item. Sit-low in the hand, solid lockup, minimal muzzle flip.
physical_description.primary_material: Steel-reinforced polymer frame with cold-hammer-forged steel slide and barrel. Polymer is high-durability engineering-grade, not cosmetic-grade.
physical_description.finish: Matte black polymer frame with a brushed steel slide showing minor tool marks from manufacturing. No glossy coating—practical industrial finish designed to avoid glint and conceal wear.
physical_description.color_scheme: Flat matte black (frame, grips) with brushed charcoal steel (slide, barrel, controls). Minimal contrast. Three-dot sights in white or tritium.
physical_description.grip_texture: Aggressive checkered polymer—functional texturing, not aggressive styling. Thumb rest slightly raised. Grip panels are integral to frame with subtle finger grooves.
distinctive_features: Blocky, functional rail system under frame (Picatinny-compatible)
Traditional steel three-dot sight system with visible dovetail cuts
Slide serrations front and rear, deeply cut for positive purchase
Ambidextrous safety levers, flush with frame
Magazine release is lever-style, oversized for gloved operation
Minimal dust cover, angular and sharp
Takedown lever is simple pin-in-hole design
Chamber witness holes visible on slide
No manufacturer flourish or tactical styling cues
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Kang-Petrov Arms logo (stylized KPA monogram) stamped on slide above trigger guard. Model designation 'KP-19' on right side of frame in small block lettering. Serial number on frame rail. Caliber stamp on barrel hood. All markings are recessed, not raised—designed to reduce snagging.
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually found in one of two states: either meticulously maintained (corporate security contractor with strict armory standards) or well-worn (field-carried every day for years). Either way, functionally perfect. Cosmetic scratches and holster wear are normal and expected. No mud or corrosion—these are cleaned regularly because they're work equipment.
